questions.question_english: When disposing of scrap or unserviceable material through public auction, what preliminary financial exercise should the competent authority or committee ideally perform?

Determine a reserve price or a reasonable assessed scrap value.
Disclose the minimum acceptable price in the newspaper advertisement.

questions.explanation_english: Prior to disposing of scrap or unserviceable materials through public auction or tender, the competent authority or evaluation committee must determine a reserve price based on reasonable assessed scrap values. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। स्क्रैप या अनुपयोगी सामग्रियों के निपटान से पहले, सक्षम प्राधिकरण या मूल्यांकन समिति को उचित आंका गया स्क्रैप मूल्य के आधार पर एक आरक्षित मूल्य निर्धारित करना चाहिए। आरक्षित मूल्य निर्धारित करने से सार्वजनिक संपत्ति के कम मूल्यांकन से बचा जा सकता है और निपटान के दौरान आने वाली बोली का मूल्यांकन करने के लिए एक मानक प्रदान किया जाता है।

questions.question_english: A Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) was placed under suspension for six months due to a disciplinary inquiry, receiving only a subsistence allowance. Upon reinstatement without exoneration, the period was treated as 'non-duty.' What happens to the NPS contribution for this period?
options_english: The government will retrospectively deposit its full 14% employer share into the PRAN, while completely exempting the employee from contributing.
The DDO is required to deduct 10% from the monthly subsistence allowance received by the employee and regularly deposit it into the NPS.
The government will only suspend the employee's contribution.
There will be no impact on the NPS contribution.
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is option B. According to the General Financial Rules, during the period of suspension, the employee is entitled to receive a subsistence allowance, from which a deduction of 10% is mandated for the NPS contribution. This ensures that even during non-duty periods, the employee continues to contribute towards their retirement savings, albeit at a reduced rate. This rule is in place to maintain the continuity of the NPS account and secure the employee's future financial stability.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों के अनुसार, निलंबन के दौरान, कर्मचारी को जीविका भत्ता प्राप्त होता है, जिसमें से NPS योगदान के लिए 10% की कटौती अनिवार्य है। यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि गैर-ड्यूटी अवधि के दौरान भी कर्मचारी अपनी सेवानिवृत्ति बचत में योगदान जारी रखता है, हालांकि कम दर पर। यह नियम NPS खाते की निरंतरता बनाए रखने और कर्मचारी की भविष्य की वित्तीय स्थिरता को सुरक्षित करने के लिए है।
key_facts: NPS contributions are mandatory during periods of suspension with a deduction from subsistence allowance.
Printed answer key: (B) The DDO is required to deduct 10% from the monthly subsistence allowance received by the employee and regularly deposit it into the NPS.

questions.question_english: Identify the correct statement regarding the condemnation of stores.
options_english: Any non-gazetted Group C employee holding stock custody can independently declare office items as condemned.
An item may be declared surplus, obsolete, or unserviceable on recommendation of a Condemnation Committee.
Condemnation of government assets can be processed entirely on paper without conducting any physical inspection.

questions.explanation_english: Condemnation of public property requires formal evaluation by a duly constituted Condemnation Committee or Board. questions.question_english:
Consider the following statements regarding partial withdrawals from the NPS Tier I account:
I. A subscriber can make a partial withdrawal only after completing three years of membership.
II. The withdrawal amount cannot exceed 25% of the subscriber’s own contributions (excluding employer contribution and returns).
III. Partial withdrawals can be made up to a maximum of three times during the entire tenure.
IV. The partial withdrawal amount is fully taxable in the hands of the subscriber.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
options_english: I, II, and III
II, III, and IV
I, III, and IV
I, II, III, and IV
questions.explanation_english: The correct statements are I, III, and IV. A subscriber can indeed make a partial withdrawal only after three years of membership, and the amount withdrawn cannot exceed 25% of the subscriber's own contributions. However, the statement regarding the number of withdrawals is incorrect; a subscriber can make partial withdrawals up to three times during their entire tenure. The withdrawal amount is fully taxable, which is an important consideration for subscribers planning their finances.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is INCORRECT regarding the physical verification of library books as per GFR?

Any loss of a book must be recovered from the Librarian’s salary without inquiry.
For libraries having more than 20,000 but up to 50,000 volumes, verification should be done at least once in three years.

questions.explanation_english: Any loss of a book must be recovered from the Librarian’s salary without inquiry. Rules permit writing off up to five volumes per thousand issued or consulted books annually as normal wear and tear. Automatically recovering book values from a librarian’s salary without conducting an inquiry is arbitrary and prohibited.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। किसी पुस्तक के खोने पर उसे बिना जांच के पुस्तकालयाध्यक्ष के वेतन से वसूल किया जाना चाहिए। वित्तीय नियम मानते हैं कि सार्वजनिक पुस्तकालयों में छोटी पुस्तक हानियाँ स्वाभाविक रूप से होती हैं। नियम प्रति हजार जारी या परामर्श की गई पुस्तकों में से पांच पुस्तकों को सामान्य पहनावा और आंसू के रूप में लिखने की अनुमति देते हैं। बिना जांच किए पुस्तकालयाध्यक्ष के वेतन से पुस्तक के मूल्य को स्वचालित रूप से वसूल करना मनमाना और निषिद्ध है।
